title: Launch: similar books + taste model
summary: Recommendations blend two models: similar books (item-kNN over readers' ratings) and a taste model (ALS fold-in). The taste model's share grows with the number of ratings, a(n) = n/(n+20), and heavy readers get a small popularity penalty.
settings: No prediction floor or boost; uncapped blend weight; popularity penalty -0.3; no recency. Ratings: item means shrunk toward the global mean, no calibration (reconstructed).

title: Prediction floor
summary: For you leaves out books whose calibrated predicted rating is below the reader's own average minus 0.25 stars, so books they'd probably rate below their usual stay off the list.
settings: Adds the floor (average - 0.25); no prediction boost; uncapped blend weight; popularity penalty -0.3; no recency. Ratings: calibrated to the reader's scale for every book (no evidence gate), item means shrunk toward the global mean (reconstructed).

title: Fame-gated prediction boost
summary: Well-known books the reader would likely rate highly move up the ranking: the predicted rating gets a small weight, scaled by how widely read the book is on Goodreads, so obscure books with high averages don't jump the queue. Item means were also shrunk toward Goodreads-wide averages, and each predicted rating is now calibrated to the reader's scale only as far as their own ratings support it.
settings: Adds the boost (0.75, fame 10k to 316k ratings); uncapped blend weight; popularity penalty -0.3; no recency. This is the first champion under the temporal evaluation.

title: Taste model capped at 40%
summary: With long reading histories, the similar-books model predicts what people read next better than the taste model, so the taste model's share of the blend is capped at 0.4 and the heavy-reader popularity penalty goes to -0.5. Tuned on the validation readers.
settings: a(n) = min(n/(n+20), 0.4); popularity penalty -0.5; no recency.

title: Recent reading counts more
summary: Each rating is weighted by how recently the book was read: its weight halves for every 25 ratings dated after it. Dates come from a Goodreads import (date read, else date added), and ratings made on the site are dated the day they're made.
settings: Recency half-life 25 ratings, on top of v4.

title: Factorization rating model
summary: Predicted ratings now start from a matrix-factorization model (16 latent factors with book and reader biases) fitted to each reader's own ratings, then add the similar-books correction as before. Predictions are about 1.6% closer to the rating readers actually gave, with the biggest gains for short histories; the recommendations themselves are unchanged.
settings: Rating model: biased MF (k = 16) + item-kNN residual, evidence calibration; ranking settings as v5.
